description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a web button and a dsh_restart agent tool hand the relaunch to a detached helper that waits for the port to free, relaunches the same command, auto-reconnects the page, and shows boot errors in a recovery console when the new host fails.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键重启：网页按钮与 dsh_restart Agent 工具把重启交给独立 helper，等端口释放后以相同命令拉起新宿主，页面自动重连；新宿主启动失败时由恢复控制台显示启动错误。
